doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Conducting the funeral of the late Kalasuri, Mrs. Latha Walpola under the full state patronage
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by the Minister Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government and the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to conduct the funeral of late Kalasuri, Mrs. Latha Walpola honoured with the title “Helaye Geetha Kokilawiya’ under full state patronage on 2025-12-31, in consideration of her contribution to Sinhala Cinema and Sinhala folk music, was approved by the cabinet.
